title: (RHBA-2011:1298) JBoss Enterprise Application Platform 4.3.0.CP10 update
portal_summary:
Updated JBoss Enterprise Application Platform 4.3 packages that fix several bugs
are now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 5 as JBoss Enterprise Application
Platform 4.3.0 Cumulative Patch 10.
portal_product_filter: JBoss Enterprise Application Platform|JBoss Enterprise Application Platform|4.3.0|x86_64
JBoss Enterprise Application Platform|JBoss Enterprise Application Platform|4.3.0|i386
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously-released errata relevant
to your system have been applied.

This update is available via the Red Hat Network. Details on how to use the Red
Hat Network to apply this update are available at
https://access.redhat.com/kb/docs/DOC-11259
portal_description:
JBoss Enterprise Application Platform is the market-leading platform for
innovative and scalable Java applications. JBoss Enterprise Application Platform
integrates the JBoss Application Server with JBoss Hibernate and JBoss Seam into
a complete and simple enterprise solution.

This release of JBoss Enterprise Application Platform serves as a replacement to
JBoss Enterprise Application Platform 4.3.0 Cumulative Patch 9, and provides a
number of bug fixes. Users are directed to the JBoss Enterprise Application
Platform 4.3.0 Cumulative Patch 10 Release Notes for information on the most
significant of these changes:

https://docs.redhat.com/docs/en-US/JBoss_Enterprise_Application_Platform/4.3/html/Release_Notes_CP10/index.html

Warning: Before applying this update, back up the server/[configuration]/deploy/
directory of your JBoss Enterprise Application Platform, along with all other
customized configuration files.

All users of JBoss Enterprise Application Platform 4.3 on Red Hat Enterprise
Linux 5 are advised to upgrade to these updated packages.
